decisions.reason: Choosing a simpler modeling approach does not change the requirement to deliver the working model in Excel or the prohibition on substituting the error-prone PDF.
The simpler-model decision is already owned by the usability Requirement and does not alter the existing government-use or professional, clear, and strongly presented qualities of this candidate.
The source does not change the required DSCR and equity-IRR targets or authorize a simpler sizing rule.
The general request for a simpler model does not change the selected operating-cost range, full-network scope, provisional status, or assumption-disclosure rule.
The source does not change the twelve-site structure, authoritative site list, typologies, or treatment of missing site-level data.
Although the financing structure is already streamlined, the source does not modify its 55/45 allocation, approximate rate, tranche structure, or provisional status.
A simpler modeling approach does not resolve or change the AUD currency, 2031 price base, or the existing currency ambiguity concerning the CAD-denominated opex input.
The source does not remove or change the required separate presentation of digital-platform, program-management, and contingency or reserve costs.
The source does not change the requirement to provide the equity IRR output or its 16–20% target range.
The source does not authorize simplifying or replacing the required asset-appropriate CCA, depreciation, tax-shield, or equity-return treatment.
A simpler model remains compatible with the existing reference, provisional-input, and assumption-disclosure rules; the source does not modify or remove them.
The source does not change the required conclusion or evidence standard showing that availability-style payments are necessary for viability and bankability.
